    A nilpotent categorical radical as Hom-ideal data #

    The current categorical-radical predicate is morphismwise. Iyama's ladder argument also needs powers of that radical. This file gives the exact bridge: a two-sided additive Hom ideal whose membership predicate is the categorical radical, together with a nilpotence exponent.

    Nilpotence is stronger than Iyama's general J^∞ = 0 hypothesis, but is the appropriate finite condition for the acyclic word mesh categories used in the manuscript.
